pr_title: Fix toolchain detection for worktree-local paths
pr_body:
Reimplements `pet::EnvironmentApi`, trying to access the `project_env` first
Closes #20177 

Release Notes:

- Fixed python toolchain detection when worktree local path is set

issue_context.title: Toolchains installed via nix are not detected for Python
issue_context.body: ### Check for existing issues - [X] Completed ### Describe the bug / provide steps to reproduce it See the [reproduction repository](https://github.com/WeetHet/zed-toolchains-bug-reproduction.git) for reproduction In short, zed does not detect the accessible python toolchain when started from the Dock if they are installed via `nix` and accessible through `direnv`. It does detect them when started from the terminal ### Environment Zed: v0.161.0 (Zed Nightly c41a8e33a0aa05708b6e21731e7e708a8f34e6c3) OS: macOS 15.0.1 Memory: 8 GiB Architecture: aarch64 ### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help explain present your vision of the feature

review_comments: This looks a bit like a copypaste of impl from pet itself; could we instead make `EnvironmentApi` a bit like a facade where it looks paths up in `project_env`, and if that fails, it uses `pet_core::os_environment::EnvironmentApi` (that can be it's another member)?
